name: slop-obliterator
description: Kills AI-slop output across UI, prose, and code. 89 deterministic rules run against a real rendered page (side-tab borders, icon tiles, indigo accents, gradient text, glassmorphism, nested cards, marquees, bounce easing, buzzwords, contrast, focus rings, form states) plus 11 judgement checks, an OKLCH design-token generator, offline icon search, and skills that force a real design decision at every fork where a model would reach for a default.
